objectives: To provide essentials in Earth Sciences to non-geologist students
content: Plate tectonics, Minerals, Sedimentary / Igneous / Metamorphic rocks and how they form, Weathering and soils, Time in Geology (relative and absolute dating), Basics on geological maps, Natural hazards, Natural resources, Running water and groundwater
books:
Earth: an introduction to Physical Geology, by Tarbuck, Lutgens ＆ Tasa (2020 - or older editions).
Complement in Chinese: 普通地質學(1983), by何春蓀.
